hits.text:
NEW APP!!! 🚀
In the age of security incidents, I figured we need to be more careful with how we treat secrets in our clipboard.
So I built this: ClipAudit.app (macOS app)
- It automatically detects 713 types of API keys and secrets and conceals them from other apps that read your clipboard in under <1ms.
- Detect and scrubs secrets out of your shell history (bash, zsh, etc.).
- Secrets in your clipboard will auto-clear after 90s, and accessing them again requires Touch ID.
- Hide your secrets while you are in screen recording or screen sharing mode.
- Everything is 100% offline, on-device processing, and encrypted with macOS Keychain.
ClipAudit is also a fully featured clipboard manager, so now I replace Alfred / Raycast with this!
Check it out 👉 ClipAudit.app
Let me know what you think! 😄
